text:
maya: Quick sync — follow-ups from the authz/token incident. Need clear owners + timelines for remediation items before EOW. Who can take which?

devon: I can own token validation hardening (replay detection + stricter TTL checks). Target: patch + canary by Wed.

nina: I'll own audit logging gaps — check retention policy + missing logs for service accounts. ETA Friday for a doc and sampling script.

igor: I'll take secrets rotation policy & runbook updates. I'll also verify all service-account keys rotated in last 30 days. Aim: tomorrow afternoon.

sam: I'll coordinate rollout windows with eng teams and add rollback steps to the runbooks.

maya: Thanks. Let's list the concrete action items: 1) token validation fix (devon) - Wed 2) audit retention/coverage (nina) - Fri 3) secrets rotation runbook (igor) - Tue PM 4) rollout coordination (sam) - Tue evening 5) add automated alert for perm-drift (security-oncall) - can someone take?

security-oncall: I'll wire up a perm-drift alert (heuristic: config delta + service account key age > 45d) and a daily digest to #security. ETA 48h.

devon: For the token fix: current failure mode is missing exp checks in our legacy auth proxy. Patch is small. I'll add unit tests + integration test against `auth-proxy:local` and a canary route. Example test command I'm using:
```
pytest tests/test_token_ttl.py -k exp_check
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" http://canary.prod.internal/health
```
Will post build when green.

nina: Audit logging: found two endpoints with inconsistent logging (svc-audit and svc-sync). Quick grep: `grep -R "audit_event" services/ | wc -l` returns lower counts than expected. I'll attach sampling logs in the doc.

igor: For secrets: running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --filter="validAfterTime<\"-30d\""` and cross-checking with vault rotation tags. Found 3 keys missing rotation metadata. I'll rotate and annotate.

maya: Recurring pattern note — this is the 3rd authz-related aftercare in 90 days (token TTL, perm drift, and now audit gaps). We should propose a monthly "authz hygiene" checklist for SRE + platform teams.

sam: +1. I'll add a recurring ticket template in JIRA and link in the runbook.

security-oncall: Also proposing an acceptance test for deployments: new deploys must pass `authz-smoke` which runs a small set of perm checks and audit write/read. I can prototype it this week.

devon: Heads up: canary found a timing edge where concurrent cache invalidation leads to temporary allow. Adding KV lock + short backoff. Will update PR.

nina: FYI, retention changes might need compliance sign-off. I'll flag in the doc and add required reviewers.

maya: Good call. Please put reviewers + approvals in the ticket. Also add owners for post-deploy verification (someone to validate metrics for 24h).

igor: I'll volunteer to verify metrics after rotation for 24h.

sam: I'll schedule a 30-min handoff on Wed 10:30 to go through rollout plan and who will watch the dashboards.

maya: OK. Action summary (short):
- devon: token validation + tests — due Wed
- nina: audit coverage + retention doc + sampling — due Fri
- igor: secrets rotation runbook + rotate 3 keys — due Tue PM
- security-oncall: perm-drift alert + authz-smoke prototype — 48h/this week
- sam: rollout scheduling + JIRA template — Tue/Wed
- maya: consolidate tickets + follow up with compliance

alerts-bot: Incident summary posted: "AuthZ incident — remediation sprint started; owners assigned; next check-in Wed 10:30"

devon: I'll post the PR link once CI passes.

nina: I'll drop the sampling logs & reviewer list into the ticket and ping compliance.

maya: Thanks all. Quick ask — if you see related authz drift in other services, drop a short note in this thread so we can iterate on the checklist.

sam: Noted. I already saw a similar pattern in `payments-sync` last month. I'll add that as an example in the ticket.

security-oncall: Will post the new alert playbook and runbook fragments here when ready.

maya: Last: please mark your JIRA subtasks with `postmortem:authz-2026` so we can track closure. I'll reopen thread Wed after the handoff. :white_check_mark:
